ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution approximately 60% high-intensity (white) pixels to 40% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity central blob extending from the peduncle attachment through the median notch and laterally into both lobes. Left lobe exhibits five distinct dark-pixel linear streaks (vertical orientation). Right lobe exhibits two prominent dark-pixel linear streaks and a focal cluster of dark pixels near the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude pixel variations (serrations) localized primarily on the distal thirds of the trailing edge; the medial thirds exhibit a smoother, lower-frequency topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral convex curvature on the outer edges transitioning to a slight S-curve (concave to convex) along the trailing boundary from the notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity, irregular circular pixel formations at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes, consistent with localized surface encrustation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four roughly parallel dark-pixel tracks on the mid-left lobe and one prominent diagonal track on the mid-right lobe, representing distinct breaks in the base pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel linear rake marks on the ventral surface of both lobes; irregular topography and scarring at the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The boundary of the central black pigmentation forms a sharp 'W' shape across the horizontal axis of the fluke.
